notes.title: Wick Update: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you to all our players who made us aware of a bug that was preventing progression past the Library! This bug has been fixed now. 

Thank you all,

Studio Whip

notes.title: Wick Update: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you to all our players who have been pointing out bugs to us! We have been trying to get to all the bugs we've been made aware of, and we've fixed a couple so far.

Bug fixes in this update include:

 Added support for 2560 x 1440p
 Fixed a bug where the graphics menu was not displaying the currently selected options when being reopened
 Fixed a few places where the player could escape the map and fall into nothingness


Again, thank you for pointing out bugs, and we hope you continue to do so in the future!

Thank you all,

Studio Whip
